rules.statement: In a partition action, the judge has a duty to satisfy himself as to the identity of the land sought to be partitioned and can call for further evidence in a regular manner.
rules.supporting_quote: "In a partition action such as this is, I think that the judge has power, and that in some cases it may be his duty, even after the parties have closed their case, to call for further evidence. But if he does, he must do it in a regular manner".
